property_summary: For any callee address, C.forward forwards the call and returns (does not revert) iff the low-level callee call succeeds; the mutant inverts that check and will revert when the callee call succeeds (so for a callee that reverts the property still holds for reference but is violated for the mutant).
change_summary: Replace the require(_s) with require(!_s) so forward reverts on success instead of on failure.
